DORSET DIVISION - SITES IMPORT PACKAGE

Import the ZIP into Sites as an existing website. Keep the directory structure intact.

ENTRY PAGE: index.html
OTHER PAGES: about.html, approach.html, work.html, reviews.html, contact.html
SHARED FILES: style.css, script.js
IMAGE ASSETS: all 11 JPG files in assets/

All image files, CSS, and JavaScript are physically inside this ZIP. Images use relative paths (assets/...). Animations are implemented in CSS and script.js, not as separate video files.

EXTERNAL SERVICES (not image dependencies):
- Google Fonts loads online for custom typefaces; fallback fonts are defined in CSS.
- Booking buttons go to Cal.com.
- Email/phone links use mailto:/tel:.
- Reviews link currently points to the PeoplePerHour homepage, pending the exact profile URL.

IMPORTANT: This is the current coded website preview, not a pixel-perfect reproduction of the approved mockups. No additional image/video assets are hidden elsewhere. Contact form uses mailto and is not a server-backed submission form. Do not publish before verifying portfolio visuals, testimonial wording, and contact details.
